summary: Shadow evidence is mixed but leans toward elevated near-term pullback risk rather than a confirmed directional breakdown. The strongest current signals are breadth deterioration, negative BTC depth imbalance, ETH price weakness with rising open interest, and persistent ETH/BTC sub-0.03 trading. Positive 12- to 72-hour returns, falling funding, incomplete short-horizon anchors, lower-bound liquidation data, and unavailable macro/sentiment fields materially limit confidence. Forecasts are unratified research candidates only.
